paraphrase: Weak version: for every sentence, if its negation is meaningful, so is its double negation; that is, negation closure only for negated sentences.

self_evident.note: Floor item approved by the owner on 2026-11-05 (#1008), weak version: the weakest version defeat 2 (STRONG-VERIFICATIONISM-WITH-LAWS-FAILS) needs, which applies closure only to the negation of a testable law. Entailed by the strong version (MEANING-NEGATION-CLOSURE-STRONG-ENTAILS-WEAK). Hempel's stork example applies his biconditional adequacy condition exactly to such a pair (an existential and its negation). The recorded rival stays recorded and unrefuted, and the common-ground criterion is not mechanically met, so the premise is established relative to the owner's approval.
